blocks.text: Intellectual Property (IP) (zehni milkiyat) un qanooni rights (haq) ko kehte hain jo creations of the mind (dimagh se banayi hui cheezein) ki hifazat karte hain, jaise inventions (nayi ijad), literary aur artistic works (likhai aur fan ke kaam), designs, symbols (nishan), naam, aur karobar (commerce) mein istemal hone wali images. Yeh rights banane walon (creators) ko apne kaam par control dete hain aur us se munafa kamane dete hain, ta ke un ki creativity (nayi cheez banane ki qabliyat) aur innovation (naye tareeqe) ko pehchana jaye aur us ka inaam mile.

blocks.prompt: IP rights ko creative kaam ka inaam kyun kaha jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Kyunke kitab ke mutabiq yeh rights creators ko apne kaam par control aur us se munafa kamane ka haq dete hain; is tarah un ki creativity aur innovation ko maana jata hai aur inaam milta hai.

items: Intellectual Property: dimagh se banayi cheezon (inventions, kitabein, designs, symbols, naam) ki hifazat karne wale qanooni rights.
